name: NetApp ONTAP
author: Netlens
description: Shows a NetApp ONTAP cluster (AFF, FAS, ASA, ONTAP Select, Cloud Volumes ONTAP) with its nodes, aggregates and their fill level, volumes and LUNs, disks, the hosts that mount a volume over NFS, and the open health events. Read-only, through the ONTAP REST API (ONTAP 9.8 or newer).

info.title: Set up a read-only user on the cluster
info.text: Create a cluster user for Netlens with the readonly role and the http application, with password authentication: on the cluster shell run the first command below (it asks for the password). Enter the cluster management address (https://<cluster address>). Netlens only reads. The hosts that use a volume over NFS come from ONTAP 9.8 and newer; older clusters show everything else. Many clusters have a self-signed certificate: leave 'Verify TLS certificate' off until you installed a proper one.
info.code: security login create -user-or-group-name netlens -application http -authentication-method password -role readonly

config.label: Clusters
config.help: One line per cluster: the address of the cluster management interface and the user name and password of the read-only user.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Only used for https:// addresses. Leave this off while the cluster uses a self-signed certificate.
